description: Nagina Cotton Mills Limited was established on 16 May 1967 and describes itself as the mother company of Nagina Group. It operates 51,708 spindles with related process machinery, spinning carded, combed, core spun and fancy yarns for use on high speed looms and knitting machines, sold under the Sweet Pea and Angothi brands. The company's own profile notes that Forbes included it in its "Best under a Billion" list of 200 companies.
